findings.current: At the dread in his voice, Go Jun murmured,
findings.defect: The source describes Go Se-won’s call as mixed with both a sigh and fear. This line retains the fear but drops the sigh.
findings.rationale: 탄식과 두려움이 섞인 부름 explicitly includes both a sigh and fear in Go Se-won’s call to the Vice Guild Master.
findings.replacement: At Go Se-won’s call, tinged with both a sigh and fear, Go Jun murmured,

summary: One minor emotional detail is omitted; the rest appears faithful to the source.
